title: cyclosorus assamicus
intro: Cyclosorus assamicus, commonly known as the Assam fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities that aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus assamicus include its potential to act as an anti-cancer agent, anti-diabetic, and anti-bacterial agent, as well as its ability to help manage stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
